rationale: Captures organic uplift only. No budget risk, but leaves most of the signal-driven demand uncaptured.
Concentrates incremental spend in the four signal-affected regions. Demand is within achievable production capacity under an approved plan.

Highest modelled revenue and physically producible, but the 420000 USD incremental budget exceeds the 250000 USD limit that POL-COMMERCIAL-004 v1.0 allows a commercial approver to commit without board approval. It also spends budget in the two regions the signal does not affect, where modelled confidence is lowest.
